title: Trust, but verify
hints: Start by ruling out non-objects: `typeof value === "object" && value !== null`. After that, TypeScript still won't let you read `.id` — cast to `Record<string, unknown>` to inspect the fields.
Check each field with `typeof`. For `roles` use `Array.isArray(...)` plus `.every(r => typeof r === "string")`. For `email`, it's fine if it is `undefined`.
Write `isUser` first, then `assertUser` is two lines: `if (!isUser(value)) throw new Error("Invalid user");` — the `asserts value is User` signature does the narrowing.
